data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Tuesday, September 22, 2026: Crypto prices continue to surge to prices last seen in January
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $86,597.82 on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, 6.7% higher than Monday's opening price. As of 7:20 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin slid to $86,035.18. Ethereum opened at $2,775.96 on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, up 5% from Monday's opening price. The price of ethereum slid lower this morning to $2,734.44 as of 7:20 a.m. ET.
